description:
pkix-path/Cargo.toml:21-23 says:

    # RustCrypto algorithm backends — disable all to bring your own SignatureVerifier.
    # Currently implemented: RSA-PKCS1v15-SHA-256, ECDSA-P-256-SHA-256, and
    # ECDSA-P-384-SHA-384. Additional algorithms (Ed25519, RSA SHA-384/512)
    # are future work; see project tracker (PKIX-gphz).

But PKIX-gphz.4 already shipped RsaPkcs1v15Sha384Verifier and RsaPkcs1v15Sha512Verifier (see bd memory pkix-gphz-4-rsa-pkcs1v15-sha-384-sha). The comment should be updated to reflect that RSA SHA-384/512 are implemented; Ed25519 remains future work.

Trivial doc fix. Surfaced during PKIX-wmch implementation.
title: pkix-path: stale Cargo.toml comment claims SHA-384/512 are future work
